flow-definition.description: Mongodbserver_PITR: Point-In-Time Recovery Backup System via AWS S3

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: ACTION
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Action: Take a base full backup, an incremental oplog backup, or restore to a specific point in time.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: S3_BUCKET_NAME
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: AWS S3 Bucket name for storing continuous backups.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: TARGET_PRIVATE_IP
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Private IP of the MongoDB instance.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BASTION_IP
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Public IP of the Bastion Host (Leave empty if Jenkins can reach the Private IP directly).

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: SECRET_NAME
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Name of the AWS secret containing the SSH key.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: MONGO_CREDENTIALS_SECRET
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: AWS Secret name containing MongoDB credentials.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: FULL_BACKUP_FILE
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: For RESTORE: The tar.gz filename of the full base backup in S3 (e.g., full_backup_2026-06-09.tar.gz).

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: RESTORE_TIMESTAMP
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: For RESTORE: Unix epoch timestamp for Point-In-Time limit (e.g., 1718180000). Leave empty to restore fully.
